Hi Samira — thanks for the clear list. Concise answers below so your legal/procurement team has direct language to work with. I’ve attached our latest SOC 2 summary and a DPA template.

High-level assurances (POC / Hosted API):
- Training usage: Redwood does NOT use customer prompt or uploaded content to train or update our public model weights by default. Customer content is not injected into training datasets or weight updates unless a customer explicitly opts into a training program and signs a separate agreement.
- Data residency: For EU-region POCs we can scope processing and storage to EU-only regions. Logs and backups for EU-region hosted customers are stored in EU storage; cross-region backups do not occur for accounts flagged as EU-residency.
- Retention & deletion: Default retention for request logs and input text (hosted) is 30 days. We provide a deletion API for customer data; for hosted POC accounts we commit to completing deletion from primary storage within 72 hours of a verified request. Some transient caches (prefix/KV) are ephemeral and not persisted beyond session lifetimes unless explicitly configured.

Operational notes and exceptions:
- Aggregated telemetry (latency, error rates, anonymized token counts) is retained for product analytics; this does not contain raw customer text.
- If a customer requires stricter retention (e.g., 7-day window) or contractual language forbidding any short-term logging, we can negotiate that in the DPA/MSA and apply a dedicated config.
- Dedicated and Private deployments: when customers are on Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem) the data remains in the customer-managed environment and Redwood does not have access to customer content for model training or telemetry beyond agreed logs.

Attachments included: SOC2-report-2026.pdf, DPA-template.docx
Reference: https://redwood.ai/security/data-residency
HubSpot: hubspot:deal_4521

If you want explicit contractual language, we can provide an addendum clause: "Redwood will not use Customer Content to train or improve model weights, nor will Redwood include Customer Content in any training set, except where the customer provides explicit, documented consent." Happy to put that in the POC SOW/MSA.

If useful, we can set a short legal call — Marissa / Vivek / Hannah are on CC and can join.
